title: AstroTransit Discovery Portfolio: 10 Pure Novelty Temperate Super-Earth & Earth-Twin Candidates (ESI up to 98.66%) from TESS Photometry
description: This evidence package contains the complete discovery portfolio, MCMC posterior parameter distributions, FPP vetting reports, configuration files, and reproducibility environments for 10 uncataloged (100% Non-TOI) temperate exoplanet candidates discovered from TESS cadence light curves using the AstroTransit cascade framework.
